The Liar Man

By: Joy Summers | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Con Man or Conservationist? Tonight on Carte Blanche we expose the real lion man.

Summary:
Conservationist or Con man? A Carte Blanche exclusive expose on Craig Busch – the so called lion man. Star of his own international TV series – but those close to him reveal a dark side that uses his animals as a means only to an end. They say he is a reckless drunk who siphons money off naïve animal lovers, kicks his cats, and has beaten and threatened to kill at least two women.

We speak to the woman he has beaten, the man who owns the farm he squats on and the people who have worked closely with him.


Further information:
NOTE: CRAIG BUSCH on internet : JABULA BIG CAT SANCTUARY

Craig Busch has a long history of controversy. For years he was involved in a protracted court battle with his mother over ZION Wildlife Gardens. During that time a number of incidents took place including the death of the Zimbabwean animal handler Craig had taken to New Zealand.

Now in South Africa he hopes to bring his other cats to South Africa.

TINUS THE LAND LORD
Four years ago Tinus sold his game farm Zandfontein to Craig Busch who paid the deposit but four years later has not paid him the balance owing. Effectively squatting on Tinus land and shooting Tinus’s game to feed his lions when he cant get enough other meat. Tinus is well into his seventies and this farm was his retirement. This is now a matter for a court case. Every time Tinus tries to get onto his land – Craig refuses him access

FRED BARRINGER LEOPARD CONSERVATIONIST
Fred Barringer spent 5 months working with Craig Busch. Two weeks in the waterburg doing leopard rescues. We have photos and some footage.
They were supposed to go overseas together as part of a one world fund raising trip to raise money for conservation.

Fred says it wasn’t long before he realized that Craig was a con man who used animals only to fund his lifestyle.

Fred drew a line in the sand when he watched Craig repeatedly hitting his white lion Jabula repeatedly on the nose, forcing the lion to climb on a chair and watch TV so he could get a shot of it. The lion was lying on his back snarling in the end.

“I had been very tolerant until then because of the fund raising charity but after that I just walked away.”

I have information of Craig ripping off the UK charities – funding that was supposed to go to them was re routed. We will speak to Jude and John Jones and Paula Figgens about how they raised money and Craig ripped off the charity.




MARLENE AND THEO
They both worked for Craig looking after the animals. They too realized he is a con man and an alcoholic – a very different Craig to the image he projects on his international animal series. Craig left for several months to go to new Zealand. He left them no money and they had to use their own meagre salaries to find food to feed the lions.
Theo also has photo evidence of a rhino horn in a marked evidence bag that Craig has not returned to the Hawks after a film shoot.


Theo was horrified the way Craig forces lion cubs to integrate with cheetahs. He has photos and says they are natural enemies and this shouldn’t be done.
We also have our own footage of Craig taking a lion through the tiger cage


STEVEN KELLY
Worked with Craig looking after the cats until the middle of 2015. He says Craig took advantage of his grief after his father died – and Steven spent over R150 000 of his inheritance to assist Craig Busch.

Steven tells stories of a man who drinks and smokes marijuana and is reckless with his animals. He also says he has seen Craig kicking the 8 month old tiger cub and calling it a ****He has also seen him kicking Shaya for scratching someone.
Both Theo and Steven independently tell the story of a man who drinks excessively and sleeps till late in the day.

Steven tells the story of how Craig tried to kill a donkey with a hand gun and kept missing – the donkey was running around wounded and eventually Prosper had to stab it in the head with a screwdriver just to kill it.


SUSAN EISENHUT
A former fiancé who is now living in hiding after she alleges that Craig in a drunken rage tried to kill her in New Zealand and drag her into the lion cage. There are two witnesses. After that she left new Zealand. She says she never went to the police because then she would have had to stay and she feared for her life.

Craig had beaten her up and hit her in the kidneys before that. We have witnesses who can confirm both these incidents.

LEONIE
Former girlfriend of Craigs. ( Still have to see if I can convince her to speak on camera. He threatened her with a knife)


ZENDA THE GIRAFFE
There is a young tame giraffe on the property – we have photos and footage – Craig says it was a rescue but neither Steven nor Theo believe that story – and both independentantly are convinced that Craig killed the mother and took the giraffe to tame it for his TV show. ( More evidence to be found before we can make the allegation)

BUYING LIONS FROM LION HUNTERS
Craig bought Zantyn the lion from Ukuthula – from Willie Jacobs and has never paid him for it.
He also has a relationship with another known lion hunter Nazeer Cajee

ILLEGAL WEAPONS AND A FORMER CRIMINAL RECORD
Last year Mike Driscoll – once a close friend of his organized him a tempory gun license for his Glock 17, 2 shotguns and a Magnum .375 – Mike is now back living in Wales but will do a skype interview about how the true nature of his so called friend emerged when he lived with him on the property. He doubts if he still has a valid gun license ( to be investigated still)

LYING ABOUT THE CUBS
He tells the public that Shaya’s cubs were kept with her for a year but the truth is actually when the cubs were ten days old he removed them from the mother.

TEMBI THE LION
Craig raises funds by taking tourists on a walk with him and a lion. In our case he took Tembi a fully grown hungry lion for a walk with our two researchers. During the walk Tembi lunged towards Sasha and Craig had to climb on her back to try and restrain her. Our sources say that Craig is reckless and has covered up other incidents – where a tourist lost a finger when Jabula the lion bit her. Susan was a witness

THE LION IN THE FREEZER
Craig has a reality TV show that follows different lions. The lion died when they weren’t actually shooting which was most inconvenient. So Craig froze the lion and when they were back shooting he defrosted the lion over two days and made up a story about the lions death and had a huge funeral for it on the first episode.

Press Release:


Lion Man
Craig Busch calls himself the lion man on his international TV series. He left New Zealand, bought himself a farm in South Africa and called it Jabula Big Cat Sanctuary. It’s home to his cheetahs, tigers, his lions and his giraffe Zenda. But following reports that Craig is not the animal lover he purports to be, Carte Blanche investigates.


Script:


LIONMAN FINAL SCRIPT

Commentary One
In 2010 international wildlife celebrity Craig Busch left New Zealand and soon after bought himself a farm in Africa. Its home to his cheetah’s, his giraffe Zenda, his tigers and his lions. He named it the Jabula big cat sanctuary after this magnificent male.

Up Sound Craig
Hi my name is Craig Busch, the lion man

Commentary two
Craig is not new to big cat sanctuaries. In New Zealand he owned a park with his mother, but they fell out over filming rights and in an ugly legal battle Craig lost everything.

Derek LINK
Craig had lost the park, lost the cats and in some quarters had lost his reputation as the lion man so he headed to SA to make a fresh start.

Craig upsound
Out of concern for wildlife and the almighty greed of mankind there is a calling within me to come to Africa and be a part of Africa

Commentary Three
Craig’s series on Discovery’s Animal planet projects him as a conservationist and animal lover, but nothing could be further from the truth says Fred Berrange of the Leopard conservation project

Derek
So are you saying he is not a true conservationist
Fred
You can’t even use that word in the same sentence as Craig Busch, seriously.

Commentary four
Fred has spent his adult life saving leopards in distress. Shortly after Craig arrived here, they began filming a series in the Waterburg. At the time Craig was accompanied by Jabula then an eight- month old cub

Fred
I never saw affection for Jabula while we were filming. He was always bullying him to try get the shot
Derek
So you think it was all about the picture
Fred
Absolutely! That is all that it was about …it was about him and his fame that is all it was ever about.

Up sound Craig and giraffe

Commentary Five
This is Zenda the giraffe, she was born on the farm, but when she was only few hours old, Craig accompanied by the neighbours son went to remove her from her mother. Fransisca Garcia, a qualified welder working on the farm, witnessed what happened and took these photo’s

Fransisca
And Craig was all excited, arranged for a trailer, went and fetched the creature brought it there to his house and he still said to me if any body asks about it just say just say the mother pushed it away.

Derek
He told you to lie about it?
Fransisca
He told us, and then he was on the phone telling the whole world he just got himself a giraffe. Poor thing could hardly stand on its feet yet

Commentary six
But the story Craig tells in his series, is how he saved an abandoned giraffe

Up sound Craig with giraffe
Normally you have got to dart these guys, but I managed to catch her. We are going to save you the jackals are not going to get you

Commentary seven
But this testimony from an eye witness at the time suggests that Craig nearly killed the giraffe just to get his shots

Patrick VO
I thought Zenda and the lead was awful. They wanted to create catching the baby giraffe on film, so they dragged her down into the bush with the lead. I was there as well. We spent about half a day doing this. Zenda always trying to run off- at one point she was getting so badly choked she dropped down to the ground. She wasn’t fit to raise her head. She was still breathing but I thought she was a gonner. I am sure so did everyone else. She had to rest for about an hour

Fransisca
I just left it like that. I knew this is not right. Its not right taking an animal away from its mother.

Commentary eight
And Fred began to see the real Craig Busch when during their filming, he kept pestering Fred to capture a baby leopard



FRED
He had been asking me to capture a baby leopard so that he can rear it the way he did Jabula. I said I don’t do that, you can’t take a baby away from its mother

Commentary nine
Their agreement collapsed when funds raised for this leopard, were allegedly diverted by Craig for his own ends. The leopard had been trapped for 9 days in this cage, had aborted its cubs, and lost its teeth trying to chew its way out. In the UK funds were raised for a collar

Fred
the woman said Craig got hold of the donor and rerouted the funds to him – we have to release this animal – so it cost me selling furniture to get the R10 000 for the collar

Then came the final straw for Fred

Fred
And the one incident was we went to film and that was the last straw when Craig had Jabula at the end of the chain beating him with a stick to watch television/ Jabula was on his back snarling – and Craig just kept hitting and beating him and I was saying what are you doing?! This is not what I want to be involved with!

Commentary ten
In October last year one of Craig’s lioness’s Shaya gave birth, but shortly afterwards Craig removed the cubs which he defends as standard practice.

Craig Busch
We just pulled these boys off just yesterday – four lovely boys. Cubs do better if you hand raise them in captivity.

Commentary eleven
We sent in researchers under cover to see his sanctuary for ourselves. By now the cubs had grown into boisterous youngsters.

Up sound Craig bites the cubs ear and it squeals

Commentary Twelve
It appears that he has an odd way of disciplining his animals, but when guests arrive it all looks above board

Up sound Nikola and Sasha
He is so beautiful. He is like ridiculous!

Link
Craig says he loves his lions and gives the impression that he is the lion whisperer but some of the people that worked with him tell a very different story


Commentary thirteen
Theo Potgieter and his wife Marlene worked for Craig.

THEO
Well we thought he was an amazing human being looking after animals and always putting the animals first and never himself – once we started working there we saw a different thing coming out of his house at 12 the afternoon only waking up

Commentary fourteen
Marlene raised this cub Tembi. She watched Craig force the terrified cub to interact with his cheetahs, and learn to walk on a lead.

Marlene
He would drag her so often and do it gradually he would force her on the leash one day…she got hold of the chicken and he got very angry and started to kick her I was crying my eyes out and I said to Theo- this is a man that is supposed to love animals

Commentary fifteen
Eventually Marlene and Theo left disillusioned

Derek
How are you left feeling about Craig?
Marlene
I am sad. I don’t watch reality shows any more because its all a scam and I hate what he is doing to those lions

Commentary sixteen
Tembi is now a grown lioness and a source of income for Craig. Fifteen hundred rand will buy you a walk….. or a drag around the property

Up sound
Thembi don’t be difficult

Craig up sound dragging her

Commentary seventeen
Steven Kelly volunteered to help on the farm last year after his dad died. He too witnessed Craig dragging Tembi around the farm.

Steven
He sold me this whole concept that we are enriching this captured lion life …lion lies down …you are not really loving the lion you are loving the money that people are paying you to walk the lion

Commentary eighteen
Craig has taken out an interim harassment order against Steven after Steven sent a barrage of unpleasant messages to him

Steven
Every time I was with him we drank most of the time
He would go in after drinking …directly contradicting himself

Commentary nineteen
The allegations against Craig Busch are not flattering. His detractors call him the liar man, and he has a criminal record in New Zealand for drunk driving and assault. Craig does not deny that he has been involved in a criminal matter in New Zealand and has paid a fine
But he wouldn’t come on camera.

Derek
We have got other allegations that you have treated your lions badly, that you have beaten up women
Craig
I don’t do that. I love my cats Ok. I don’t do that and I am sick of smear campaigns

Commentary Twenty- one
But even the farm that Craig now calls his own, actually still belongs to Tinus Rautenbach

Tinus
Derek I hesitate to say…I would never ever trust him for whatever he said and that is enough said

Commentary Twenty- two
Tinus hoped to fund his retirement when he sold his farm in Magaliesburg to Craig for R4.5 million rand, but he alleges Craig hasn’t paid for it.

Tinus
We agreed on a price and he said ok he would give a R1million deposit and within the next four to five months he would pay the balance

Commentary twenty three
But five years later Tinus says Craig has reneged and never paid the balance. Craig says that they have instituted a substantial counterclaim against Tinus but Tinus still has the title deeds and cancelled the contract with Craig in November 2014

Derek
You can’t get on to your own farm
Tinus
No …he is not available and I have to get the lawyer …and it’s a constant problem
…to stop him squatting on my farm.

Commentary Twenty- four
In a legal letter to Carte Blanche Craig says he would never abuse his animals as that would jeopardise his own safety. He denies that he would place any of his animals under his care at risk, or that any funds received and earmarked for the animals had been misappropriated

THE END 10 04

PROMO ONE 10
Commentary
Craig Busch promotes himself as a lover of big cats

Derek
So are you saying he is not a true conservationist
Fred
You can’t even use that word in the same sentence as Craig Busch, seriously.

PROMO TWO 15 seconds
Commentary
We speak to former employees of Lion Man Craig Busch
Marlene
I am sad. I don’t watch reality shows any more because its all a scam and I hate what he is doing to those lions

PROMO THREE 15 seconds
We send in our undercover team to the Jabula big cat sanctuary where you can pay to walk with the lions

Up sound Craig and giraffe Commentary Five This is Zenda the giraffe, she was born on the farm, but when she was only few hours old, Craig accompanied by the neighbours son went to remove her from her mother. Fransisca Garcia, a qualified welder working on the farm, witnessed what happened and took these photo’s Fransisca And Craig was all excited, arranged for a trailer, went and fetched the creature brought it there to his house and he still said to me if any body asks about it just say just say the mother pushed it away. Derek He told you to lie about it? Fransisca He told us, and then he was on the phone telling the whole world he just got himself a giraffe. Poor thing could hardly stand on its feet yet Commentary six But the story Craig tells in his series, is how he saved an abandoned giraffe Up sound Craig with giraffe Normally you have got to dart these guys, but I managed to catch her. We are going to save you the jackals are not going to get you Commentary seven But this testimony from an eye witness at the time suggests that Craig nearly killed the giraffe just to get his shots Patrick VO I thought Zenda and the lead was awful. They wanted to create catching the baby giraffe on film, so they dragged her down into the bush with the lead. I was there as well. We spent about half a day doing this. Zenda always trying to run off- at one point she was getting so badly choked she dropped down to the ground. She wasn’t fit to raise her head. She was still breathing but I thought she was a gonner. I am sure so did everyone else. She had to rest for about an hour Fransisca I just left it like that. I knew this is not right. Its not right taking an animal away from its mother. Commentary eight And Fred began to see the real Craig Busch when during their filming, he kept pestering Fred to capture a baby leopard FRED He had been asking me to capture a baby leopard so that he can rear it the way he did Jabula. I said I don’t do that, you can’t take a baby away from its mother Commentary nine Their agreement collapsed when funds raised for this leopard, were allegedly diverted by Craig for his own ends. The leopard had been trapped for 9 days in this cage, had aborted its cubs, and lost its teeth trying to chew its way out. In the UK funds were raised for a collar Fred the woman said Craig got hold of the donor and rerouted the funds to him – we have to release this animal – so it cost me selling furniture to get the R10 000 for the collar Then came the final straw for Fred Fred And the one incident was we went to film and that was the last straw when Craig had Jabula at the end of the chain beating him with a stick to watch television/ Jabula was on his back snarling – and Craig just kept hitting and beating him and I was saying what are you doing?! This is not what I want to be involved with! Commentary ten In October last year one of Craig’s lioness’s Shaya gave birth, but shortly afterwards Craig removed the cubs which he defends as standard practice. Craig Busch We just pulled these boys off just yesterday – four lovely boys. Cubs do better if you hand raise them in captivity. Commentary eleven We sent in researchers under cover to see his sanctuary for ourselves. By now the cubs had grown into boisterous youngsters. Up sound Craig bites the cubs ear and it squeals Commentary Twelve It appears that he has an odd way of disciplining his animals, but when guests arrive it all looks above board Up sound Nikola and Sasha He is so beautiful. He is like ridiculous! Link Craig says he loves his lions and gives the impression that he is the lion whisperer but some of the people that worked with him tell a very different story Commentary thirteen Theo Potgieter and his wife Marlene worked for Craig. THEO Well we thought he was an amazing human being looking after animals and always putting the animals first and never himself – once we started working there we saw a different thing coming out of his house at 12 the afternoon only waking up Commentary fourteen Marlene raised this cub Tembi. She watched Craig force the terrified cub to interact with his cheetahs, and learn to walk on a lead. Marlene He would drag her so often and do it gradually he would force her on the leash one day…she got hold of the chicken and he got very angry and started to kick her I was crying my eyes out and I said to Theo- this is a man that is supposed to love animals Commentary fifteen Eventually Marlene and Theo left disillusioned Derek How are you left feeling about Craig? Marlene I am sad. I don’t watch reality shows any more because its all a scam and I hate what he is doing to those lions Commentary sixteen Tembi is now a grown lioness and a source of income for Craig. Fifteen hundred rand will buy you a walk….. or a drag around the property Up sound Thembi don’t be difficult Craig up sound dragging her Commentary seventeen Steven Kelly volunteered to help on the farm last year after his dad died. He too witnessed Craig dragging Tembi around the farm. Steven He sold me this whole concept that we are enriching this captured lion life …lion lies down …you are not really loving the lion you are loving the money that people are paying you to walk the lion Commentary eighteen Craig has taken out an interim harassment order against Steven after Steven sent a barrage of unpleasant messages to him Steven Every time I was with him we drank most of the time He would go in after drinking …directly contradicting himself Commentary nineteen The allegations against Craig Busch are not flattering. His detractors call him the liar man, and he has a criminal record in New Zealand for drunk driving and assault. Craig does not deny that he has been involved in a criminal matter in New Zealand and has paid a fine But he wouldn’t come on camera. Derek We have got other allegations that you have treated your lions badly, that you have beaten up women Craig I don’t do that. I love my cats Ok. I don’t do that and I am sick of smear campaigns Commentary Twenty- one But even the farm that Craig now calls his own, actually still belongs to Tinus Rautenbach Tinus Derek I hesitate to say…I would never ever trust him for whatever he said and that is enough said Commentary Twenty- two Tinus hoped to fund his retirement when he sold his farm in Magaliesburg to Craig for R4.5 million rand, but he alleges Craig hasn’t paid for it. Tinus We agreed on a price and he said ok he would give a R1million deposit and within the next four to five months he would pay the balance Commentary twenty three But five years later Tinus says Craig has reneged and never paid the balance. Craig says that they have instituted a substantial counterclaim against Tinus but Tinus still has the title deeds and cancelled the contract with Craig in November 2014 Derek You can’t get on to your own farm Tinus No …he is not available and I have to get the lawyer …and it’s a constant problem …to stop him squatting on my farm. Commentary Twenty- four In a legal letter to Carte Blanche Craig says he would never abuse his animals as that would jeopardise his own safety. He denies that he would place any of his animals under his care at risk, or that any funds received and earmarked for the animals had been misappropriated THE END 10 04 PROMO ONE 10 Commentary Craig Busch promotes himself as a lover of big cats Derek So are you saying he is not a true conservationist Fred You can’t even use that word in the same sentence as Craig Busch, seriously. PROMO TWO 15 seconds Commentary We speak to former employees of Lion Man Craig Busch Marlene I am sad. I don’t watch reality shows any more because its all a scam and I hate what he is doing to those lions PROMO THREE 15 seconds We send in our undercover team to the Jabula big cat sanctuary where you can pay to walk with the lions Invoicing Back references from Insert ID in Invoice: Title Author Last Updated Invoice for The Liar Man (4751) Joy Summers 26 July 2016

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Con Man or Conservationist? Tonight on Carte Blanche we expose the real lion man.
metadata.Summary: Conservationist or Con man? A Carte Blanche exclusive expose on Craig Busch – the so called lion man. Star of his own international TV series – but those close to him reveal a dark side that uses his animals as a means only to an end. They say he is a reckless drunk who siphons money off naïve animal lovers, kicks his cats, and has beaten and threatened to kill at least two women. We speak to the woman he has beaten, the man who owns the farm he squats on and the people who have worked closely with him.
metadata.Further information: NOTE: CRAIG BUSCH on internet : JABULA BIG CAT SANCTUARY Craig Busch has a long history of controversy. For years he was involved in a protracted court battle with his mother over ZION Wildlife Gardens. During that time a number of incidents took place including the death of the Zimbabwean animal handler Craig had taken to New Zealand. Now in South Africa he hopes to bring his other cats to South Africa. TINUS THE LAND LORD Four years ago Tinus sold his game farm Zandfontein to Craig Busch who paid the deposit but four years later has not paid him the balance owing. Effectively squatting on Tinus land and shooting Tinus’s game to feed his lions when he cant get enough other meat. Tinus is well into his seventies and this farm was his retirement. This is now a matter for a court case. Every time Tinus tries to get onto his land – Craig refuses him access FRED BARRINGER LEOPARD CONSERVATIONIST Fred Barringer spent 5 months working with Craig Busch. Two weeks in the waterburg doing leopard rescues. We have photos and some footage. They were supposed to go overseas together as part of a one world fund raising trip to raise money for conservation. Fred says it wasn’t long before he realized that Craig was a con man who used animals only to fund his lifestyle. Fred drew a line in the sand when he watched Craig repeatedly hitting his white lion Jabula repeatedly on the nose, forcing the lion to climb on a chair and watch TV so he could get a shot of it. The lion was lying on his back snarling in the end. “I had been very tolerant until then because of the fund raising charity but after that I just walked away.” I have information of Craig ripping off the UK charities – funding that was supposed to go to them was re routed. We will speak to Jude and John Jones and Paula Figgens about how they raised money and Craig ripped off the charity. MARLENE AND THEO They both worked for Craig looking after the animals. They too realized he is a con man and an alcoholic – a very different Craig to the image he projects on his international animal series. Craig left for several months to go to new Zealand. He left them no money and they had to use their own meagre salaries to find food to feed the lions. Theo also has photo evidence of a rhino horn in a marked evidence bag that Craig has not returned to the Hawks after a film shoot. Theo was horrified the way Craig forces lion cubs to integrate with cheetahs. He has photos and says they are natural enemies and this shouldn’t be done. We also have our own footage of Craig taking a lion through the tiger cage STEVEN KELLY Worked with Craig looking after the cats until the middle of 2015. He says Craig took advantage of his grief after his father died – and Steven spent over R150 000 of his inheritance to assist Craig Busch. Steven tells stories of a man who drinks and smokes marijuana and is reckless with his animals. He also says he has seen Craig kicking the 8 month old tiger cub and calling it a ****He has also seen him kicking Shaya for scratching someone. Both Theo and Steven independently tell the story of a man who drinks excessively and sleeps till late in the day. Steven tells the story of how Craig tried to kill a donkey with a hand gun and kept missing – the donkey was running around wounded and eventually Prosper had to stab it in the head with a screwdriver just to kill it. SUSAN EISENHUT A former fiancé who is now living in hiding after she alleges that Craig in a drunken rage tried to kill her in New Zealand and drag her into the lion cage. There are two witnesses. After that she left new Zealand. She says she never went to the police because then she would have had to stay and she feared for her life. Craig had beaten her up and hit her in the kidneys before that. We have witnesses who can confirm both these incidents. LEONIE Former girlfriend of Craigs. ( Still have to see if I can convince her to speak on camera. He threatened her with a knife) ZENDA THE GIRAFFE There is a young tame giraffe on the property – we have photos and footage – Craig says it was a rescue but neither Steven nor Theo believe that story – and both independentantly are convinced that Craig killed the mother and took the giraffe to tame it for his TV show. ( More evidence to be found before we can make the allegation) BUYING LIONS FROM LION HUNTERS Craig bought Zantyn the lion from Ukuthula – from Willie Jacobs and has never paid him for it. He also has a relationship with another known lion hunter Nazeer Cajee ILLEGAL WEAPONS AND A FORMER CRIMINAL RECORD Last year Mike Driscoll – once a close friend of his organized him a tempory gun license for his Glock 17, 2 shotguns and a Magnum .375 – Mike is now back living in Wales but will do a skype interview about how the true nature of his so called friend emerged when he lived with him on the property. He doubts if he still has a valid gun license ( to be investigated still) LYING ABOUT THE CUBS He tells the public that Shaya’s cubs were kept with her for a year but the truth is actually when the cubs were ten days old he removed them from the mother. TEMBI THE LION Craig raises funds by taking tourists on a walk with him and a lion. In our case he took Tembi a fully grown hungry lion for a walk with our two researchers. During the walk Tembi lunged towards Sasha and Craig had to climb on her back to try and restrain her. Our sources say that Craig is reckless and has covered up other incidents – where a tourist lost a finger when Jabula the lion bit her. Susan was a witness THE LION IN THE FREEZER Craig has a reality TV show that follows different lions. The lion died when they weren’t actually shooting which was most inconvenient. So Craig froze the lion and when they were back shooting he defrosted the lion over two days and made up a story about the lions death and had a huge funeral for it on the first episode.
